name: Mahathir Mohamad
summary: A Malay nationalist and developmental statist who ran Malaysia for 22 years with state-led industrialisation, privatisation, Bumiputera preferences and tight security and press laws, then returned in 2018 on an anti-corruption platform. Abroad he attacked Western dominance of the UN, trade rules and finance, defended developing countries' right to develop first and championed the Palestinian cause.
